question: Which state topped the Swachh Survekshan Awards 2023 in the category of cleanliness among states?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Maharashtra​​**.__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• President Droupadi Murmu presented** Swachh Survekshan Awards 2023.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Swachh Survekshan Awards 2023** recognized **Maharashtra as the state with the highest cleanliness standards.**
 
• MP Chief Minister Mohan Yadav expressed happiness over** Indore, from Madhya Pradesh, securing the cleanest city award for the 7th consecutive time.**
 
• **The state's dedication to cleanliness is evident as it received the second position in the overall state cleanliness category.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Indore's Remarkable Achievement:**

 
 
• Indore has been awarded the cleanest city in the country for the** 7th consecutive time** in the Swachh Survekshan Awards 2023.
 
• This recognition underscores the city's consistent efforts toward maintaining high cleanliness standards.
 
 
 
• **Surat's Excellence in Cleanliness:**
 
 
• Surat also received the cleanest city award in the **category of more than one lakh population**, emphasizing the city's commitment to cleanliness.
 
 
 
• **Top Three Clean Cities in the Sub-One Lakh Population Category:**
 
 
• **Sasvad **in Maharashtra, **Patan **in Chhattisgarh, and** Lonavala** in Maharashtra secured the top three positions in the **cleanest cities category for populations below one lakh.**
 
 
 
• **State-level Achievements:**
 
 
• **Maharashtra was awarded the first prize for cleanliness in the state category**, recognizing its overall commitment to cleanliness.
 
• **Madhya Pradesh secured the second position **in the state category, while **Chhattisgarh** received the award for the** third **cleanest state.
 
 
 
• **Cleanest Ganga Towns:**
 
 
• **Varanasi **and **Prayagraj **in Uttar Pradesh were recognized as the Cleanest Ganga Towns, showcasing their efforts in maintaining cleanliness along the Ganges.
